label: Open-circuit voltage
subgoals: Open the output terminals so no load current flows
Drop any resistor that carries no current
Solve the remaining network for the terminal voltage

label: Thevenin resistance
subgoals: Replace voltage sources by shorts and current sources by opens
Combine the remaining resistors as seen from the terminals
Report the combination as the Thevenin resistance

label: Norton current and maximum power transfer
section: Norton current and maximum power transfer
subgoals: Divide the Thevenin voltage by the Thevenin resistance
Set the load resistance equal to the Thevenin resistance
Compute the peak power as voltage squared over four times resistance
